title: SUSUKINO.
author: MIKI Yoshihito. (#mikiyoshihito)
why: Susukino crossing at night: the Susukino Bldg with the lit NIKKA 'King of Blenders' sign and neon-lined Ekimae-dori, bare street trees (late-March 2015 set) — exact place + night + cold season. Fisheye-ish wide lens (curved edges) but the sign stays central. Non-MIKI alternative: Kanesue 'すすきの Susukino' (CC BY 2.0, flickr.com/photos/kanesue/14121711133) — portrait, summer.
